core_principles.anti_distraction_rule: Strict prohibition of realistic CGI environments (no cars, streetlamps, trees, asphalt). Objects are abstract illuminated masses, particles, and glowing vectors.

ARCHETYPE_1.name: Kinetic Vector Stage
ARCHETYPE_1.layout: Full 3D Stage (100% canvas) with subtle isometric grid floor, floating telemetry HUD (top-left), glowing particle actor with vector arrows, and bottom exam anchor pill.

ARCHETYPE_2.name: Dual-Pane Orthogonal Split
ARCHETYPE_2.layout: 50/50 vertical division: Left pane displays abstract 1D/2D physical simulation; Right pane displays synchronized real-time plotted graph curve with shaded definite integral areas.

ARCHETYPE_3.name: Molecular Micro-Reactor
ARCHETYPE_3.layout: Microscopic chamber with semi-permeable or molecular boundaries, floating luminescent atomic particles/spheres with velocity collision paths, and reaction condition telemetry.

ARCHETYPE_4.name: Formula Deconstruction HUD
ARCHETYPE_4.layout: Hero equation centered with dynamic variable illumination, downward glowing bracket annotations for parameter conditions, and full-width amber NEET trap warning banner at bottom.

ARCHETYPE_5.name: Master Neural Constellation
ARCHETYPE_5.layout: Deep-space 3D holographic neural constellation map showing all 8 to 15 chapter concept nodes interconnected with glowing fiber paths, spotlighting 'YOU ARE HERE'.
